stream: FAMILY-GENESIS (TRACKER G4b) -- batch-gate manifest rewritten by genesis-integrate (2026-08-04) so tools/probe_batch.py can resolve every file's declared BASE
gate_schema_note: Every entry declares 'file' + 'base' (probe_batch BASE_KEYS: base | derived_from | derives_from | template | passing_sibling | parent_rung | known_sibling). The .rfa probes' base is the AUTHENTIC Autodesk-2026 family ARCHETYPE the family constructors read for STRUCTURE + the schema constant (rvt.famgen.famdoc_adoc.TEMPLATE_DONOR = rvt.famgen.skeleton.DEFAULT_DONOR). It lives under vendor/ (not experiments/ or samples/), so its 'base' value is a dict whose FIRST value is the absolute path (what today's gate regex resolves) followed by the repo-relative path (the manifest convention); both resolve to vendor/phi-ag-rvt/examples/Autodesk/racbasicsamplefamily-2026.rfa. The archetype is NOT viewer-certified and NO standalone .rfa has ever been read by the viewer, so the .rfa probes are (correctly) refused as 'base not certified' until Round F1 certifies the archetype -- see 'rounds'. The L_v2 project rung is admissible TODAY (base = the certified rst sample source).
law: docs/inbox/genesis-discipline.md: every batch = a certified BASE + >= 1 certified CONTROL (auto-added by `probe_batch.py stage` from the newest certified file on disk); a candidate BASE is staged with --candidate-base and certified by its own PASS before anything built on it may be read.

reference_files.archetype_what: the authentic Autodesk-shipped Revit-2026 sample family (racbasicsamplefamily-2026.rfa, from the phi-ag/rvt example corpus) -- read for the family-document SHAPE (239-slot family-editor AppInfo registry, per-registry row grammar) and the format constants (Formats/Latest per-release schema; unit footer / end-record tokens); every donor-EXPRESSION value (element ids, names, memory) is purged from the v2 files (docs/inbox/family-genesis.md). It is the family-domain analogue of samples/*.rvt: an Autodesk-authored SOURCE, never certified because the viewer has never been shown a standalone .rfa.
reference_files.host_certified_sibling_ledger: certified: 'OUR generated family (level head) LOADED into a working project via the four-registry loader' (docs/coverage/viewer-certified.json)

candidate_bases.stage_with: tools/probe_batch.py stage --candidate-base vendor/phi-ag-rvt/examples/Autodesk/racbasicsamplefamily-2026.rfa (the gate adds the round's certified CTRL_* control automatically)
candidate_bases.tests: THE FAMILY-DOMAIN ORACLE: does Autodesk's reader open an authentic Autodesk-2026 standalone .rfa at all? No .rfa has ever been read by the viewer -- this is the first family-format upload. Its PASS certifies the archetype as the family lineage's base source (list it in viewer-certified.json 'certified'), which admits every v2 .rfa probe below; its FAIL means the viewer does not read standalone family files (then the family question rides ONLY on the load-into-project path: L_v2 / L1a), and no .rfa probe is meaningful.
candidate_bases.if_PASS: the reader opens 2026 standalone families; the archetype is CERTIFIED (family lineage base) -> stage Round F2 (FG1..FG5) with it as the declared base
candidate_bases.if_FAIL: the reader/oracle does not process standalone .rfa (a viewer capability boundary, NOT a defect of ours) -> abandon the standalone .rfa probes; the family-genesis question is answered by the project-load rungs (L_v2, L1a) alone
candidate_bases.calibration_note: rvt.famgen.famdoc_adoc.validate_family_file scores the archetype WORSE than every v2 file (2 family-mode consistency errors -- its GraveyardRec/DIT layouts are outside our project-calibrated decoders -- and 5 raw-arbiter residuals vs the v2 files' 0/0 family-mode + 3 raw residuals): the raw-arbiter residuals are calibration gaps, not defects, exactly as the family-genesis assay concluded
